item.title: Marion County is not South Florida, so stop trying to make it like that.
item.description: "The county commissioners keep approving any and all requests for new housing developments, car washes, and whatever else someone wants to build. There is no end to it. If we keep on this way, there will be a car wash on every corner and there won't be a tree left in Marion County. Not to mention that the wildlife has no where to go. Marion County is not South Florida. Stop trying to make it like that." - A Marion County resident shares his opinion. Read more: Marion County is not South Florida,
